mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.idempotency_keys (id, scope, actor_key, request_key, request_hash, status, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{r.id}, #{r.scope}, #{r.actorKey}, #{r.requestKey}, #{r.requestHash}, 'PROCESSING', #{r.createdAt}, #{r.expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (scope, actor_key, request_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, scope, actor_key, request_key, request_hash, status, result_resource_type, result_resource_id, CAST(result_summary AS text) AS result_summary, created_at, completed_at, expires_at FROM public.idempotency_keys WHERE scope = #{scope} AND actor_key = #{actorKey} AND request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.idempotency_keys SET status = 'COMPLETED', result_resource_type = #{resourceType}, result_resource_id = #{resourceId}, result_summary = CAST(#{summary} AS jsonb), completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.import_jobs (id, import_type, batch_id, configuration, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{j.id}, #{j.importType}, #{j.batchId}, CAST(#{j.configuration} AS jsonb), 'VALIDATED', #{j.createdBy}, #{j.createdAt})
INSERT INTO public.import_rows (id, job_id, row_number, normalized_payload, created_at) VALUES (#{r.id}, #{r.jobId}, #{r.rowNumber}, CAST(#{r.normalizedPayload} AS jsonb), #{r.createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.import_rows AS r SET committed_resource_type = v.resource_type, committed_resource_id = v.resource_id FROM (VALUES (CAST(#{c.rowNumber} AS integer), CAST(#{c.resourceType} AS text), CAST(#{c.resourceId} AS uuid)) ) AS v(rn, resource_type, resource_id) WHERE r.job_id = #{jobId} AND r.row_number = v.rn

UPDATE public.import_jobs SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_by = created_by, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, confirmed_result = CAST(#{result} AS jsonb), row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'VALIDATED'
